productCorrections.trigger: FAIL in initial homepage/language regression during integration
productCorrections.finding: Home mockup caption referenced a translation key before dictionary integration completed.
productCorrections.fix: Use an available localized caption key and synchronize static Hebrew summaries with the shared dictionary.
productCorrections.rerun: Affected homepage/language runners repeated; final results recorded in regression summary.

productCorrections.finding: Three product meta descriptions concatenated sentences without punctuation.
productCorrections.fix: Add sentence boundaries in welcome, kitchen and blessing HE/EN metadata; no product facts changed.
productCorrections.rerun: All seven product metadata and static/dynamic language checks in the final acceptance matrix.

productCorrections.finding: No-JavaScript controls were disabled semantically but visually resembled enabled controls.
productCorrections.fix: Scoped product CSS opacity 0.55 for disabled language/gallery buttons. Enabled controls unchanged.
productCorrections.rerun: Independent keyboard/no-JS visual check and final no-JS product matrix after the style change.

productCorrections.trigger: Default-motion regression FAIL, reproduced with physical Tab/Enter after fonts/images loaded
productCorrections.finding: CSS smooth scrolling let focus scrolling overtake a native fragment jump, leaving the correctly focused collection heading above the viewport.
productCorrections.fix: Use native immediate anchor scrolling in shared CSS; preserve HTML links and focus semantics, with no new navigation JavaScript.
productCorrections.rerun: Full collection suite, six focused default-motion keyboard/mouse scenarios with/without JavaScript, and homepage navigation regression.

qaHarnessCorrections.trigger: FAIL in hero-specific regression after language child passed
qaHarnessCorrections.finding: Unscoped hero-caption selector also matched the catalog mockup disclosure.
qaHarnessCorrections.fix: Scope the existing exact disclosure/ALT assertion to .hero-visual. Focused hero rerun reuses the independently completed language child results; default hero runner still runs both.
